about: Drawings with hand-stated expected configurations for domain::stereo_drawing. Atoms: [element, x, y] in document coordinates (y down); the fixture index i is atom a(i+1). Bonds: [first, second, kind, mark] with kind - or =, and mark empty, W (wedge), H (hash) with the narrow end at the first listed atom, W< or H< with the narrow end at the second, w (wavy) or x (crossed). expect.centers lists a center, a neighbor order (atom indexes, H for the implicit hydrogen, LP for a lone pair) and the turn over that order: clockwise, anticlockwise or unknown. expect.double_bonds lists a bond index, its two references (atom indexes) and the relation: same, opposite or unknown. refused names the expected reason and whether RDKit assigns chirality to that drawing (null: not asserted). rdkit_differs, where present, says why RDKit 2022.03.2 reads a fixture differently from the stated expectation; scripts/verify-stereo-rdkit.py checks every fixture against RDKit and fails when a fixture without that field disagrees or one with it agrees.
